_comment: Mirrors functions/trpc/deno.json's imports, because these suites import the
trpc routers directly — the CCPA unit tests pull in routers/ccpa/*, which
needs pdf-lib and jszip. This map previously carried a four-entry subset
pinned to different versions (supabase-js 2.38.4 via esm.sh against the
runtime's 2.86.0 via npm:), so the tests exercised a different client than
production and could not load the CCPA modules at all.
Paths are relative to this file, i.e. packages/supabase/tests/, so they are
one level shallower than the trpc copies.
